description: This is a modern indoor staircase with a sleek design. The treads are made of light-colored wood, offering a warm contrast to the dark structure of the staircase. The handrail is a simple wooden beam, and the side features a translucent glass panel that extends upwards, creating a contemporary and open feel. The overall construction suggests a focus on clean lines and minimalistic aesthetics, integrating seamlessly into a modern interior. The staircase is illuminated by ambient light, highlighting its geometric form and materials.
